description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Opencart Admin Controller Mail Affiliate, responsible for handling email notifications related to affiliate approval and denial actions within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods to send emails to affiliates upon approval or denial, with support for email configuration and multilingual templates.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliate email notifications, including approval and denial email actions, with support for multilingual email templates and configurable SMTP settings.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Send an approval email to an affiliate after approval, including store and language-specific content.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Send a denial email to an affiliate after denial, with proper store and language context.
